zh: 我们对他表示热烈的欢迎；因为这个人的有趣之处几乎是可鄙之处的一半，而且我们已经好几年没见到他了。

as of the contemptible about the man,

text: Well, I may venture so far as to say that the paper gives its holder a certain power in a certain quarter where such power is immensely valuable.
zh: 好吧，我可以大胆地说，这份报纸赋予了其持有者在某个领域的一定权力，而这种权力是非常有价值的。
chunks: that the paper gives its holder a certain power

text: The document in question—a letter, to be frank—had been received by the personage robbed while alone in the royal boudoir.
zh: 这份文件——坦率地说，是一封信——是被抢劫的人物在皇家闺房里独自收到的。
chunks: by the personage robbed while alone

text: Again he converses, for some fifteen minutes, upon the public affairs.
zh: 他再次谈论了大约十五分钟的公共事务。

text: But this, of course, cannot be done openly.
zh: 但这当然不能公开进行。

text: Beyond all things, I have been warned of the danger which would result from giving him reason to suspect our design.
zh: 除此之外，我还被警告说，如果让他有理由怀疑我们的设计，将会带来危险。

text: They sleep at a distance from their master’s apartment, and, being chiefly Neapolitans, are readily made drunk.
zh: 他们睡在离主人公寓很远的地方，而且主要是那不勒斯人，很容易喝醉。

text: This is barely possible,” said Dupin.
zh: 这几乎是不可能的，”杜宾说。

text: He has been twice waylaid, as if by footpads, and his person rigorously searched under my own inspection.
zh: 他曾两次被伏击，就像用脚垫一样，他的人在我亲自的检查下被严格搜查。

text: I have had long experience in these affairs.
zh: 我在这些事务上有长期的经验。

text: Then we have accurate rules.

zh: 例如，一粒钻头灰尘就会像苹果一样明显。

zh: 你说奖励多少钱？”杜宾问道。

text: Why—puff, puff—you might—puff, puff—employ counsel in the matter, eh?—puff, puff, puff.
zh: 为什么——噗，噗——你可以——噗，噗——在这件事上聘请顾问，嗯？——噗，噗，噗。
chunks: in the matter, eh?— puff, puff, puff.

text: But,” said the Prefect, a little discomposed, “I am perfectly willing to take advice, and to pay for it.
zh: 但是，”省长有点不安地说，“我非常愿意接受建议，并为此付出代价。

text: The Parisian police,” he said, “are exceedingly able in their way.
zh: 巴黎警察，”他说，“非常有能力。

text: A certain set of highly ingenious resources are, with the Prefect, a sort of Procrustean bed, to which he forcibly adapts his designs.
zh: 对于省长来说，一系列高度巧妙的资源就像一张普罗克拉斯底斯床，他强行适应它的设计。
chunks: to which he forcibly adapts his designs.

zh: 当然，他有一些猜测的原则；这仅仅取决于对对手精明程度的观察和衡量。

zh: 我说，“如果我没理解错的话，推理者的智力与其对手的智力的识别取决于对对手智力的评估的准确性。

zh: 你错了；我很了解他；他两者都是。

zh: 例如，随着一门值得更好事业的艺术，他们将“分析”一词引入到代数中。

chunks: with which it has been received.

zh: 但数学家从他的有限真理出发，通过习惯进行论证，就好像它们具有绝对普遍的适用性——正如世界确实想象的那样。

text: I knew him as a courtier, too, and as a bold intriguant.
zh: 我也知道他是一位朝臣，而且是一位大胆的阴谋家。

text: You will remember, perhaps, how desperately the Prefect laughed when I suggested, upon our first interview, that it was just possible this mystery troubled him so much on account of its being so very self-evident.
zh: 也许你会记得，当我在我们第一次采访时提出，这个谜团可能因为它是如此不言自明而让他如此困扰时，长官是多么绝望地笑了。

zh: 第二天早上，我叫人要了鼻烟盒，我们非常热切地继续前一天的谈话。

zh: 如果我做了你建议的疯狂尝试，我可能永远不会活着离开部长级会议。
chunks: Had I made the wild attempt you suggest,
I might never have left the Ministerial presence alive.

D——, at Vienna once, did me an evil turn, which I told him, quite good-humoredly, that I should remember.
zh: D——有一次在维也纳对我做了坏事，我很幽默地告诉他，我应该记住这一点。

text: When, therefore, the fair Scheherazade insisted upon marrying the king, and did actually marry him despite her father’s excellent advice not to do any thing of the kind—when she would and did marry him, I say, will I, nill I, it was with her beautiful black eyes as thoroughly open as the nature of the case would allow.

zh: 这种可怕的禽类没有我们能察觉到的头，而是完全由腹部构成，腹部非常肥大、圆润，质地柔软，光滑、闪亮，有各种颜色的条纹。

zh: 魔法师们驯养了几种非常奇特的动物。例如，有一匹巨大的马，它的骨头是铁，它的血是沸水。
